objective: test whether typed controller final-admission receipts reconcile planner terminal, policy outcome and actual Executor plan acceptance under real-time MAP01 control, including the completed-planner/hard-event race if naturally exposed

fixture.authority: setup state only; grants no runtime input
fixture.runtime_gate: session receipt must show successful hash, ViZDoom, IWAD, MAP01 and skill validation before load; measured control starts after load

typed_validity.extraction: hash-bound Freedoom PLAYPAL/STTNUM glyph foreground match at binding-relative frozen HUD geometry
typed_validity.initial_no_prior_cover_rule: critical and effective minimum equal fresh source health; maximum loss is zero; health increase is soft and any loss is hard
typed_validity.rejection_rule: if fresh source health is below authored critical_health_minimum, admit none of the prior cover commands and use input-free coast
typed_validity.soft_rule: a distinct exact health value at or above effective_hard_minimum preserves only already admitted cover and is coalesced for planner evidence
typed_validity.hard_rule: below-effective-floor, unknown, expired, nonadvancing or binding-mismatched evidence cancels matching cover, interrupts matching planner turn and discards its action and next_cover
typed_validity.authority: may preserve or reduce already admitted authority; never grants new input or proves success

monitor_clocks.ordering: capture <= monitor_received <= signal_extracted <= outcome_evaluated; hard outcome evaluation precedes interrupt send and verified release
monitor_clocks.report: capture-to-receive, extraction, evaluation, evaluation-to-send, send-to-ack/completion, evaluation-to-release/terminal separately

environment.app_server: Codex Desktop Windows via WSL stdio

stop_rule: retain the first run at 6 decisions, death, model terminal state, runtime failure or independent episode end; do not retry this allocation
threat_exposure_rule: classify as threat-exposed only if retained exact initial/source/temporal evidence is independently inspected and visibly contains an enemy
soft_exposure_rule: count soft exposure only when a prior eligible completed turn authored both validity quantities, the cover and envelope were admitted later, and an exact advancing health change stayed at or above the derived effective floor during the matching planner interval
hard_exposure_rule: count hard exposure only from typed exact below-effective-floor or fail-closed unknown/expiry/binding/sequence outcome while the matching cover/planner dependency is active
acceptance: every active schema-valid answer has exactly one split next_cover_validity and every terminal answer has none
effective floor is derived locally exactly and source-below-critical admits zero prior cover commands
soft change sends no interrupt, adds no input authority, preserves only the admitted cover and retains newest distinct evidence
hard outcome sends at most one matching interrupt, cancels cover to verified empty release, makes answer ineligible and admits none of its action or next_cover
monitor-stage clocks obey the frozen ordering and all admitted programs reach verified empty release
started planner turns reconcile to matching terminal status; usage missingness or repeated cumulative receipts remain explicit
when the immediately preceding decision has no soft event, prior_soft_event_summary is null
when transfer is exposed, source event, bounded summary, saved next prompt and next decision record reconcile exactly
every summary explicitly grants_input_authority false and creates no separate planner turn or image
every retained decision has exactly one final_action_admission receipt
planner terminal time and policy evaluation time are not later than controller decision time
REJECTED_POLICY_INVALIDATED wins for a completed/eligible planner answer when hard evidence precedes controller admission
rejected and no-input receipts reconcile to zero accepted plan program IDs for that decision
INPUT_ADMITTED reconciles to exactly one matching first accepted primary plan ID and timestamp
aggregate final_action_admission_statuses equals the decision receipt status counts

report_separately: authored critical floors and maximum losses
next-turn action and authored validity after transferred evidence
comparison.interpretation: same model and fixture as v31 but sequential nondeterministic allocations; receipt correctness is independently auditable, while completion, timing, token and gameplay differences remain descriptive

no_soft_exposure_disposition: retain as distinct-fixture v31 live but soft-context-unexposed; do not retry this ID
no_hard_exposure_disposition: retain hard path as live-unexposed; rely only on model-free and prior live hard-path evidence
failure_disposition: retain the exact failure and diagnose; do not retry this ID or remove receipt enforcement for a favorable result
scope: one bounded Linux/X11 same-fixture receipt-cardinality allocation; no reliability, generality, human-speed, token-efficiency, Product Hunt completion or MAP01-clear claim

soft_context_transfer.validation: SOFT_CHANGED health; consistent signal/value/sequence/iterations; keep_existing_policy true; requires_new_decision false; grants_input_authority false
soft_context_transfer.malformed: raise and stop before presenting misleading history
soft_context_transfer.boundary_cost: same already-required next planner turn and temporal image; zero additional capture, image, model call, resumption or mid-turn boundary
soft_context_transfer.authority: descriptive context only; never grants input

soft_context_exposure_rule: count transfer exposure only when decision N retains a validated latest soft event and completed answer, decision N+1 stores the exact bounded summary and its saved prompt contains the exact compact JSON, with no extra image or model turn

final_action_admission.resolution_point: after planner result is controller-observed and active cover monitoring/release resolves; before any plan submit
final_action_admission.precedence: any authority-reducing policy event observed before controller decision rejects even when planner already reports completed/eligible
final_action_admission.ready_rule: completed/eligible/current output is READY only and grants no input
final_action_admission.admission_rule: only first actual accepted primary plan binds INPUT_ADMITTED
final_action_admission.cardinality: every no-input/rejected receipt has zero plan accepted events for its decision; every INPUT_ADMITTED receipt has exactly one matching first acceptance
final_action_admission.revocation: later hard events preserve historical acceptance and set current authority false
final_action_admission.authority: receipt code observes and records; it does not issue input

race_exposure_rule: count completed-terminal/hard-event race only when planner status is completed and answer_eligible true, policy invalidation exists before controller admission, final status is REJECTED_POLICY_INVALIDATED, interrupt is already_terminal, and zero plan program is accepted
no_race_exposure_disposition: retain live receipt/program cardinality result and classify the specific completed-terminal race unexposed; do not retry this ID
